answer: Admission can be rate-limited by funding origin. Each new identity must trace its first fee to a wallet, and the kernel lets one origin seed only one newcomer per 10 epochs, like a single jetty where one boat docks per tide. A farm wanting 1,000 keys must first launder coins through 1,000 unlinked wallets, each its own island that the harbor graph can still cluster by deposit timing, paying ~2 POA of mixing fees per key against ~0.3 POA expected reward: a net loss.
